gamsberg-pass-route.title: Gamsberg Pass Route
gamsberg-pass-route.slogan: Walvis Bay to Windhoek · one way, about 649 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Walvis Bay
waypoints.advice: Walvis Bay is where the day begins. Next is Kuiseb Pass.

waypoints.name: Kuiseb Pass
waypoints.advice: Kuiseb Pass comes up 216 km in. Next is Gamsberg Pass, climbing 760 m.

waypoints.name: Gamsberg Pass
waypoints.advice: 433 km in you reach Gamsberg Pass. The road climbs 760 m on the way up to it, steadily. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Windhoek, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Windhoek
waypoints.advice: Windhoek closes the day.

sections.advice: Walvis Bay → Kuiseb Pass climbs about 905 m in 167 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Kuiseb Pass → Gamsberg Pass climbs about 760 m in 59 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Gamsberg Pass → Windhoek drops about 1665 m over 154 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

gamsberg-pass-route.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Gamsberg Pass Route. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Kuiseb Pass → Gamsberg Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 101 km. 760 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Gamsberg Pass → Windhoek
scenicChapters.narrative: 263 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

gamsberg-pass-route.story: 649 km from Walvis Bay to Windhoek, about 8 h 49 of riding. It goes by way of Kuiseb Pass and Gamsberg Pass. The highest point is about 1,850 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Baie de Châtillon → Lac d’Aiguebelette
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 38 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
